description: This Java source file defines the SecureWindowActivity class, demonstrating how to create an activity with a secure window using WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE. It includes setup in onCreate() to set the activity's content view and enable window security.

classes.name: SecureWindowActivity
classes.description: An Activity subclass that demonstrates how to secure its window content using FLAG_SECURE to prevent screenshots and mirroring of sensitive information.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets its content view, and applies the secure window flag to prevent content from being captured or mirrored on non-secure displays.
